crusadecraft.toast.coalition.body: %s realms band together against you: your expansion worries them.

crusadecraft.letter.ai_war.subject: Declaration of war
crusadecraft.letter.ai_war.body: By this letter, %s declares war on you. Casus belli: %s. Look to your defences: our armies are on the march.
crusadecraft.letter.peace_white.subject: An offer of white peace
crusadecraft.letter.peace_white.body: This war has lasted long enough. By this letter, %s proposes that everyone goes home, giving nothing up. Seal it, and peace will be made.
crusadecraft.war.threat.title: Threat
crusadecraft.war.threat.desc:
Your conquests and wars worry your neighbours, and their opinion suffers for it.
Each conquered province adds 20, each declaration of war 5; it falls back every day.
Above %s, those who fear you band together in a coalition.
